title: Juicy Spiced Malaysian Tomato Stir-fry
description: A low-calorie-friendly hangover-cure dish featuring umami flavors and green cardamom pods, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: fresh cilantro
ingredients.amount: a few sprigs, chopped for garnish

instructions: Prepare the ingredients. Chop tomatoes and scallions finely.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add green cardamom pods and ginger to the pan; cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, pepper, and optional chicken broth. Cook until tomatoes are soft and juices have thickened slightly.
Fold in scallions and fresh cilantro. Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice or as a side dish.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
